trigger: Before starting a software project task that changes workflow assets from a pi session
When planning, reviewing, or validating project-governance work on the pi platform

native_entry.note: pi natively loads AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context files (no trust gate) and implements the Agent Skills spec: SKILL.md trees discovered recursively, name/description injected into the system prompt, full instructions loaded on demand, /skill:name commands. Global wiring uses settings.json skills/prompts path arrays pointing at repo-absolute paths (user ruling #1).

ask_user_question.evidence: extension-bridged: adapters/pi/extension registers model-only tool ask_user_question rendering via ctx.ui dialog methods (select/confirm/input) — available in tui and rpc modes (rpc via extension_ui_request/response subprotocol). Runtime E2E verified 2026-10-16 (EVD-1715): tool visible in the pi tool inventory and the headless fallback criterion PASS — in headless runs (-p / --mode json) with no UI the tool fails fast with the structured GOV_ASK_USER_HEADLESS error, which is bounded behavior on the no-UI boundary, not a capability gap; interactive boundaries route to the outer host conversation there. DEC-359 upgrade threshold satisfied (EVD-1716).

sub_agent.evidence: extension-bridged: adapters/pi/extension registers model-only tool dispatch_agent spawning a nested pi process (--mode json -p --no-session --append-system-prompt <role definition> --tools <subset> --exclude-tools ask_user_question,dispatch_agent — recursion blocked per review F-3); role-definition + task-spec + dispatch-prompt semantics align with references/agent-dispatch-template.md. Runtime E2E verified 2026-10-16 (EVD-1715/1716): dispatch_agent real-dispatch three steps machine-recorded — role read (agents/analyst.md injected via --append-system-prompt), nested run (pi --mode json -p --no-session child process), structured return (nested Analyst read adapters/pi/README.md and returned '# Pi Adapter' verbatim, exit 0); tool visible in the pi tool inventory. DEC-359 two-step upgrade threshold satisfied.

tool_calling.evidence: pi has native read/bash/powershell/edit/write/grep/find/ls built-in tools; --tools allowlist with +name/-name deltas; powershell is native on Windows.

browser.evidence: No built-in browser automation tool; pi-web-access package unverified for a declarable channel.
browser.degraded_mode: Mark browser validation blocked or run it from another host adapter.

mcp.evidence: MCP mechanism is native (mcp.json + pi mcp CLI + registerMcpServer) but server availability depends on host configuration.
mcp.degraded_mode: Use local scripts and record MCP unavailable when not configured.

git_hooks.evidence: Git hooks are repository-level controls installed into .git/hooks/ and remain active for pi-driven changes.

workflow_closure.evidence: pi achieves extension-bridged ask_user_question and sub_agent verified by runtime E2E (EVD-1715/1716, DEC-359 upgrade), native tool_calling and git_hooks; browser remains unsupported and mcp remains host-dependent.

exploration_channels.note: M10.3 four behavior-semantic channels materialized for this platform. consult never maps draw: generation is not consultation (生成≠咨询 — canonical rule marker synced from behavior-protocol.md M10.3, drift-guarded by check-cross-references; origin review-FEAT-085-DESIGN-R0 F-3). Honest degradation is legal; capability masquerade is an EXP-03 violation.

discover.evidence: No native web search tool in the pi built-in set; pi-web-access package is not a verified declarable channel.
discover.degraded_mode: Record 判定=受限 per EXP-03; degrade to local knowledge with disclosed limits; never mark offline knowledge as search results.

inspect.mapping: read / grep / find / ls native tools

consult.mapping: dispatch_agent extension bridge (nested pi role agents) for structured second opinions; no external source verified
consult.evidence: Extension-bridged sub_agent (dispatch_agent, runtime E2E passed — EVD-1715/1716) can carry consult-style role prompts; no external (web or cross-model) professional source is verified; ask_user is a user channel, not an external consult channel; draw-style generation is not consultation (R0 F-3).
consult.degraded_mode: Record the external-source limit per EXP-03 when consult needs information or judgment beyond the host's own bridged sub-agents.

validate.evidence: Native shell tools execute the validation contract commands (runtime_capabilities.tool_calling native).

exploration_channels.degraded_mode: When a channel is unavailable, record 判定=受限 in the exploration block (M10.2) per EXP-03; never mark offline knowledge as channel results.

runtime_e2e.evidence: Runtime version probe verified: pi --version returns 1.1.0 (exit 0, machine-recorded in docs/research/pi-adapter-integration-research-0.98.0.md §1). FEAT-100 acceptance E2E passed the full gate chain on 2026-10-16 (EVD-1715): L0 static check-agent-adapters 7/7, L1 isolated install smoke (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR redirected to temp dir), L2 extension load probe, L3 agent-runtime-e2e --agent pi matrix PASS (real pi loaded the e2e-test-project governance bootstrap) plus the headless fallback criterion PASS (GOV_ASK_USER_HEADLESS fast-fail, exit 0).

target_cwd_e2e.evidence: The L3 matrix entry runs real pi headless in project/e2e-test-project cwd (mixed scope per user ruling 3: real agent-dir read-only credentials + --no-session + --tools read + -na, zero write surface) and returned E2E_PLATFORM=pi; E2E_AGENT=Coordinator (EVD-1715).

agent_runtime_e2e.evidence: Real pi runtime executed the e2e prompt in project/e2e-test-project and returned E2E_PLATFORM=pi; E2E_AGENT=Coordinator with structured fields matched; headless fallback criterion PASS (GOV_ASK_USER_HEADLESS, exit 0); ask_user_question/dispatch_agent visible in the tool inventory and dispatch_agent real-dispatch three steps machine-recorded (EVD-1716).
